programs.title: Veerey Ki Wedding
programs.desc: Veerey and Geet fall in love and decide to get married. Their plan gets tossed out of the window when her peace-loving father sees Veerey getting involved in a fight, if only to protect a girl, and stamps him as a violent roadside Romeo.

programs.title: Mission Istaanbul
programs.desc: An action thriller film that follows the story of a journalist, Vikas, who is sent to Istanbul to cover a breaking news story. However, he becomes embroiled in a dangerous conspiracy involving international terrorism and political corruption. The movie features high-octane action sequences and explores themes of courage, patriotism, and the importance of journalistic integrity in a thrilling and suspenseful plot.

programs.title: Luck
programs.desc: Musa, an underworld kingpin and a firm believer in luck, designs a series of life threatening adventure sports with hefty prize money for people around the world. However, the participants can only survive and win if they are exceptionally lucky.
